title: Power Rings
description: A plugin that add custom rings with effects
body:
### Power Rings
Enhance your Minecraft experience with powerful, wearable rings that grant unique passive abilities and game-changing active skills.

Power Rings introduces a tiered jewelry system. Whether you're looking for a permanent speed boost, a life-saving invulnerability shield, or a way to boost your AuraSkills XP, there is a ring for every playstyle.


### Key Features
Dual-Tier System: Choose between Silver rings for efficient utility or Golden rings for high-powered, high-risk abilities.

Passive & Active Skills: Every ring provides a permanent buff just by sitting in your inventory, plus a powerful ability triggered by right-clicking.


### Unique Gem Families:
- Ruby: High speed and "Bloodlust" combat buffs.

- Diamond: Ultimate defense and brief invulnerability.

- Amethyst: Mobility, including vertical launches and short-range blinks.
  
- Onyx: Mining efficiency and elemental fire resistance.

- Emerald: Economic dominance with villager discounts.

- Sapphire: Deep integration with AuraSkills for massive XP boosts.

- Quartz: Stealth and area-of-effect "Soul Flares."

- Amber: Unstoppable knockback resistance and health boosts.


### Crafting & Progression
Survival-ready! Power Rings features a unique crafting progression using Enchanted Blocks.

Create Ingredients: Craft 3x3 blocks of Diamond, Iron, or Gold to create their "Enchanted" glowing variants.

Assemble the Ring: Use Enchanted Diamond blocks in the corners and your choice of Silver (Iron) or Gold sides to house your core gem.

Protect Your Gear: All rings and ingredients are protected from being accidentally placed, enchanted, or used in vanilla crafting recipes.


### Compatibility
AuraSkills: Fully compatible! Sapphire rings provide a multiplicative XP boost that stacks with your existing AuraSkills multipliers.

Inventory Logic: You can carry multiple different rings to stack their effects. If you carry both a Silver and Golden ring of the same type, the Golden passive takes priority while both active skills remain usable.


### Dependencies
Currently none but i recommend using [AuraSkills](https://modrinth.com/plugin/auraskills) for the Sapphire Ring to work

Also, shout out to xVoces for his [Rings&More resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ringsandmore) that I used in this plugin. Download his resourcepack so you could get ring textures, otherwise they are just ores.

### Commands
/pg give <player> <ring_id> [amount]

Permission: poweredgems.admin

Use this to obtain rings that don't yet have survival recipes or for admin distribution.

Wiki & Documentation: Check our [Wiki Page](https://github.com/Lemoinie/PowerRings/wiki) for full recipe details and cooldown values.
